spans.text: 0006 hours, Parking Garage No. 560.
After an intense battle, a figure steps over the corpses littering the ground and plants a foot on the roof of the car in the middle of the parking garage.
Ahahahahaha! We're here!
Are you ready, you Manhattan bitches?!
Your entrance makes you look like some kind of villain...
Hehe, games without villains are boring! ♪
A pair of petite figures follow closely behind and climb onto the car as well, with some effort.
Stop! Your lines! Why are you going off the script again?!
While I know the two of you don't have much in the way of neural cloud capacity, don't you think yours is ridiculously low?
It's just a few lines and we've rehearsed them so many times, so why can't you remember them?!
That's not it, Boss. It's just that the lines you came up with were super embarrassing...
Don't worry about it, let's skip the entrance scene and begin our invasion of Manhattan!
The Dolls look in the direction where ART556 is pointing. Before them stands Underground Parking Garage No. 560, from early 21st century.
Huh, so this is a parking garage from 50 years ago?
Looks just like Griffin's underground warehouse...
How should I put this... It's got a very historical feeling to it...
Quit being picky, ladies. Do you know how many years you'd have to work just to afford a lot in a place like this?
Why would anyone want to buy a space in a shoddy place like this?!
Boss M870, this game's been around for a long time, are you sure there'll be other players?
Of course! Didn't I pull you guys in here so we could have fun being the Manhattan Posse?
Hehe, I had a bunch of plans earlier, but I abandoned them and came here just for this.
It's all so I can enjoy being a Manhattan cop!
We get to mess around while pretending to be part of the Manhattan PD! ♪
But are we seriously not going to consider fighting for the prize?
What do you mean "pretending"? Mind your language! Being able to get the prize money is good, but our main goal here is having fun! ♪
Besides, you'll have fine money coming out of your ears as long as you hang with me! Hehehehe...
That's right! Money's not important, the point is to have fun! Hehehehe...
Yep yep, so here's to jolly cooperation!
Hehehehe...
With camaraderie in the air, the three Dolls high-five each other.
However, the moment her back is turned, ART556 moves with blinding speed and plants a sticky bomb on P7's back.
Heehee, let's see how good you really are, P7.
Your reputation precedes you, ART556. I didn't expect I'd get the chance to work with you!
Before this, I was actually kind of worried about going up against you in a prank war.
Hahahaha, then this must be fate. I'm looking forward to working together. ❤
Fate? If I hadn't pulled you two in here, you'd probably be splashing around in a mud puddle somewhere.
Yep, it's all thanks to you, Boss M870!
Thank you, Boss M870. In order to celebrate our encounter, I'm going to share some food I just found with everyone!
I left it at the garage's entrance, so wait for me here...
Awesome!
P7 can tell that something is off.
I'll go get it with you!
N-no need for that! I can manage by myself!
Aw, why so stiff? We're all from the same team, aren't we...?
ART556 tries to jump off the car roof and flee, but P7 has a death grip on her.
ART556 tries to hide her remote control with one hand and deal with P7's tugging with the other, and the struggle soon grows heated.
P7! It isn't much, so stay here and keep the Boss company!
Nonsense! It's dangerous to go alone...
The hell are you two doing? Indulging in sisterly kinship in front of me?
Trapped between the two of them, M870 separates the pair impatiently.
During the course of the struggle, ART556's remote lands on the roof of the car.
The air grows still in an instant.
Oh no!
Not bad, ART556! You work fast!
The heck is this?
Before M870 can finish speaking, P7 and ART556 are already lunging for the remote control.
Bonk— That's the sound of two foreheads colliding.
Shortly after that, the three Dolls end up locked in a big ball and roll off the car roof.
Uwah—
Owowowow...
Through dazed eyes, ART556 notices that the sticky bomb is now stuck to the car window.
As long as I can recover the sticky bomb before anyone notices, the whole thing will be over!
Was it worth scuffling over a trinket like this?
Is there catnip in there or something?
M870 fiddles with the remote control in her hand.
Huh?
Wait, that's—
M870 picks herself up and presses the remote control nonchalantly...
...At the same time, outside the parking garage.
Hey, I've got something awesome to tell you guys...
...You won another free bottle?
No! Look over there, at AK-47...
VSK-94 looks over at AK-47, not understanding what's going on.
According to the map, if we want to go to the Dark Zone, we'll have to go...
It's still so far off?! You're planning to have your trump card here walk all this way to get to the battlefield?!
THAT'S the entire length of Manhattan Island! THIS is where we...
AK-47 and SKS are feuding about the route they're going to take.
So what's the problem?
Look closely at AK-47's hand...
VSK-94 focuses her attention on the finger that AK-47 is resting on the map.
Given our progress so far, I estimate we'll take another 8 hours to get there.
...Then we'll have to pick up the pace!
Otherwise, the others will have the upper hand by the time we get there!
Da! A-91, VSK-94, we're going to pick up the pace!
Alright, no problem.
Comrades! Onward, to victory!
AK-47 holds her head up high and marches into the bone-chilling wind.
SKS dips her head to take another mouthful of soda.
Eh, the beer here is really watered down.
Do you see it?
You're not trying to tell me...that AK-47 has extra fingers...are you?
Nononono, AK-47 is MISSING fingers!
She only has five fingers on her hand! But look at me, I have eight fingers on mine!
Through her fingers, VSK-94 can see SKS wobbling over towards them.
Advance! Advance! Advance toward the objective!
Huh? How come you guys are ahead of me?
You were going the wrong way.
VSK-94 sighs heavily and drags SKS and A-91 along in an effort to catch up with AK-47.
...AK-47 suddenly comes to a halt outside the parking garage.
Hehe, this is it, Underground Parking Garage No. 560.
Woohoo!
We can ride in a car?!
If we can find a car, it'll greatly cut down the amount of time we spend on the road!
I should point out that we haven't been able to drive any of the vehicles we've encountered so far.
Aw, don't just give up, you've gotta keep trying!
Who knows, we might find a glorious steed for ourselves in there!
VSK-94 peers into the gloomy entrance of the parking garage, then looks around again at her hyped-up teammates.
Her high-speed neural cloud proceeds to envision countless scenarios where the group is wiped out, and VSK-94 sighs heavily.
Let me do the scouting.
Given our present condition, we probably won't be able to make it into the garage alive.
It'll be fine! Look, it's all quiet down there.
If you're worried, I'll chuck a bottle in and see if anything happens.
I don't think such a simple and crude method is suitable in this scenario...
AK-47 walks up to the slope leading to the garage entrance and rolls the bottle she just finished down the incline.
See! There's noth—
BOOM—
AK-47 is interrupted by a sudden explosion at extremely close range.
How many times do I have to tell you, AK-47?!
Don't go throwing your vodka bottles around!
It was a soda bottle..
Hehe, the enemy's pretty lively!
Looks like the battle's gotten very tricky. Make way and let me at 'em!
A-91 takes out her knife and points it at the darkness below.
You lot! Get out here right now!
That's A-91 for you! Spirited as ever!
Get them, A-91!
Senior! You're holding your scout firing knife the wrong way round! If you open fire like this...
VSK-94 immediately moves up to stop A-91, in the hopes of helping her correct her shooting posture.
The NRS-2 should be held with the blade towards yourself...
...What NRS?
A-91 starts struggling as she sees VSK-94 trying to take away the knife in her hand.
Hey, rookie, it's really dangerous to get close to A-91 when she's fighting!
What are you two grabbing each other for?!
What if the enemies down there open fire on you while you're like this?
AK-47 and SKS insert themselves into the battle for A-91's knife.
You-you think you can bully me just  because there's eight of you?!
What do you mean, "eight of you"? In any case, just let go!
Why are you grabbing my hand so hard?!
Just let me handle it! Stop getting in the way!
You think you can take my knife because you've got numbers on your side?
I've got a few more Molotov cocktails in reserve!
...What?!
You mean your empty vodka bottles? I tossed them long ago!
Blyat! Why do you keep throwing my bottles away, SKS?!
That's because AK-47 loves throwing them around and causing trouble!
What does this have to do with me?
Speaking of which, AK-47, what happened to that bottle you finished just now?
It's over here...huh?
As AK-47 looks down to search for the bottle, A-91 pushes away the Dolls around her with a forceful shove.
In the moment that she is pushed clear, SKS notices several bottles rolling down the slope towards A-91's feet...
Aha, my bottles!
A-91 shakily lifts a foot...
...After a tremendous explosion, the three Dolls lie dazed on the ground.
Who did that?
It was ART556!
Was it you?
Uh...
M870 stands up, towering over ART556.
ART556 can sense incredible murderous intent overflowing from her eyes.
Boss, please, I can explain...
Explain what?! How am I supposed to enforce the law when my HP's dropped this low?!
Don't get mad, Boss! There's bound to be a weaker team out there...
In our current state? Maybe if we ran into a team that was sloshed out of their neural clouds!
Or else—
Rattle rattle rattle—
A lonely soda bottle rolls down.
M870 immediately shushes herself and takes cover with P7 and ART556 behind a car.
W-what now?
Shh— Someone's coming.
The three Dolls turn their eyes toward the entrance of the parking garage and watch intently, but nothing happens...
Maybe you were hearing things?
Did the explosion damage your hearing modules?
Wait—
More time passes.
The lifespan of my kneecaps is dropping...
Can we go now, Boss?
Wait a little longer...
...An ominous voice drifts in from the entrance of the parking garage.
Wooooooooooo—
Hahahahaha the whole world's spinning!
Before Squad M870 recovers from their shock, they see a huge indistinct ball roll into the parking garage...
What on earth is that?
Looks like a bunch of boozehounds. No, wait, does this world have alcohol?
Do alcoholics need alcohol? They'll get drunk off a pint of plain water.
Look at that lot, they're happily downing bottles of soda, as though they were actually drinking beer or something.
Hehe, looks like a bunch of marks have offered themselves up to us!
Wait a second, who's that Doll over there? Don't think I've seen her before...
VSK-94? I think she's new at the base.
So she ended up teaming up with them...
She looks really strong, and she's clear-headed too.
You think we can win, Boss?
Maybe if it were just those three drunks...
Don't worry. Once we get VSK into our team, we'll be able to go even wilder, hahaha!！
Speaking of which, I just remembered something...
...On the other side of the parking garage, several Dolls awkwardly stagger to their feet.
You...what the hell's your problem?
Why'd you have to take my...my knifey?
...Your knifey?
VSK-94 grabs A-91's hand and looks carefully at it.
It looks a lot like an NRS-2 shooting knife, but turns out it's just an ordinary knife.
...Hahaha! How do you like it, rookie?
Life is always filled with surprises when you follow our squad, don't you think?!
Heart attacks, more like...
After recalling the blast from just now, VSK-94 warily observes the parking garage, looking for places where enemies might be lying in ambush.
Relax. If there were enemies around, they'd have opened fire already.
The hell are you acting so calm for, AK-47?!
How many times have I told you! Don't throw your empty bottles around!
...SKS? Why are you grabbing my collar?
Haha, sorry, I'll be more careful next time.
Come, a toast to reaching the garage safely!
We're way behind schedule as it is. Are you really going to keep drinking?
That's the vodka spirit!
If you don't get it, have a drink to clear your head!
Look, rookie, drinking is how we strengthen our bond and build rapport.
You should drink too, so you can bond with us faster!
I'm out, A-91! Give the rookie a bottle!
Huh? My vodka...?
A-91 rummages through her bag. VSK-94 can clearly see her rummaging through several bottles of soda, but in the end she decides to zip the bag up.
Too bad, I'm out of vodka too...
I'm on my last bottle myself.
Then maybe I should scout ahead!
Looks like we have no choice.
VSK-94 quickly packs her things and leaves the parking garage.
Come come come, our squad's made it this far. This calls for a celebration!
A toast to our upcoming victory!
Drink! All of you, drink! We're not stopping till we're all smashed!
M870 watches as the three Dolls tilt their heads back to down an entire bottle of soda each.
Hahahahaha! I'll go see if I can start up that car over there... (hic)
Pick a spacious one...
That way we won't be knocked around inside when we're giving the cops the slip.
There's no point. You'll hit your head on everything as long as AK-47's driving.
Shaddup, you lot! If Kalina finds out we've been driving drunk again—
Wait a  minute, we're not in Griffin now, hehehe...
Hehe, now the Commander and Kalina can't nag us anymore!
You cowards, so you didn't dare drink because of a tiny problem like that?
Yeah, right. In any case, I've never been scared before...
Anyway, they'll just check me into rehab again if they catch me...
They just lock you in a pitch black room for several days and play traffic safety rules over and over again, without a drop of liquor in sight!
I'm Griffin's trump card, you know! How could I be scared of petty things like that?
Da, da...
As they recall their painful memories, the smiles on the three Dolls' faces grow stiff.
Just then, a righteous cry thunders through the air, accompanied by a powerful searchlight beam.
You lot! Hands up!
Trying to drive when you're this drunk?
Don't think you can escape today!
Three unfamiliar figures pop up on the roof of the car beside AK-47.
We're the Manhattan P.D.!
Today is drunk driver cleanup day! Now reach for the sky!
We're the cops!
Put your hands up!
Hey, say something, will you?
Chyort vozmi! Today was clearly not supposed to be drunk driver cleanup day!
Cut the crap! RUN!
SKS, This way!
Wait a minute! Aren't we playing a game?!
Yeah, why would the Manhattan P.D. be in this crappy game anyway?
Then why the hell are you running so fast?
Pizdets! I can't help myself!
When I hear the word "police", I have the urge to run away!
You guys... Don't think you can run faster than me!
In the blink of an eye, the three Dolls have vanished without a trace.
Only Squad M870 is left, staring dumbfoundedly.
...Can Dolls run that fast?
Holy crap, it's like a dream!
Seniors, I'm back.
Boss, VSK's back!
What do we do?!
Calm down!
VSK-94 returns to where AK-47 was supposed to be, but all she sees is several unfamiliar Dolls staring sternly at her.
We're the Manhattan P.D.!
Today is drunk driver cleanup day! You there! Reach for the sky!
Hands up!
All the way up!
VSK-94 cooperates and raises her hands, as well as submitting to a breathalyzer test.
Humph, she hasn't been drinking.
Uh... Comrade officers, have you seen my teammates?
They were just here.
Are you talking about the drunkards from just now?
...Probably.
They saw us and ran!
Vanished with a whoosh~
...I knew it.
As they see the look of helplessness on VSK-94's face, M870 signals P7 and ART556.
I'm Officer M870 of the Manhattan District Police, and these two are my deputies, ART556 and P7.
Hello, Ma'am. I'm P7.
And I'm ART556, at your service.
...You're Griffin Dolls too, right?
Why call yourselves the Manhattan P.D.?
That's because it's our mission, and since we've accepted it, we'll see it through to the end.
Granted, Manhattan's a wasteland now, but we still need to step up to protect the peace.
Yep!
Exactly!
VSK-94 notices that the three Dolls are covered in wounds.
Oh, our injuries? We got caught in an explosion when we were trying to stop those drunks.
...Yeah, huh?
Wait, is that part of our story now?
It's called improvisation, just roll with it!
Thank you for your hard work.
Well, we're low on people, and my deputies here aren't too experienced either... (Sighs)
Manhattan's so big, so why are there only the three of you?
Are all the other cops gone...?
Yep. I mean, you must have seen the state of Manhattan on the way here, right?
Yes, it's quite a mess...
We've been trying to recruit comrades while protecting justice, but the results haven't exactly been ideal.
Well, that's enough about us.
Ma'am, your friends are gone. What do you plan to do now?
ART556 and P7 innocently sidle up to her, and as she looks into their clear, shiny eyes, VSK-94 is reminded of the cloudy, inebriated eyes of those boozehounds...
Honestly, this is the first time I've seen perps who were so quick to abandon a friend. Still, it's alright, our job is to help the troubled masses.
If you're worried about running into danger on your trip, we can escort you.
To serve and protect!
Is our honor!
No need for that...
I'd rather help you protect justice than help those alcoholics scrounge up more money to buy vodka.
Wait a minute. Do you mean...?
My name is VSK-94, and I once served with the police. I believe my experience should be of use.
Therefore, I hope you'll let me join you.
Why certainly! We'd be happy to have you with us!
Then I'll be in your care from now on.
Oh yeah!
That's wonderful!
Welcome, I know you'll be able to bring new strength to the Manhattan P.D.!
Right.
VSK-94 packs her things and sets off.
Behind her, three pairs of Doll eyes gleam nefariously in the darkness of the parking garage.
Hehe, we did it.
All too easy!
Another flawless plan from the Boss!
minutes ago.
Now that you mention it, I remember something...
What is it?
I once saw several police officers come to the base to look for the Commander. The Commander looked really stern, so I decided to listen in.
I think AK-47 and her fellow drunks were speeding and ended up being arrested and dragged back to the base by the cops.
Kalina had to pay a huge fine and the Commander was super mad, and AK-47 and the others were severely punished!
So you're saying they're afraid of the police...
Hahahahaha, what dorks!
Still, we might be able to use this against those three drunkards.
The problem is, I haven't figured out VSK yet. I don't know what kind of strategy would be good against her.
You mean the three of us together can't beat her?
You have the cheek to bring that up? Would we even need to hide here if you hadn't blasted off most of our HP?!
(Sniffles) I already said I was sorry!
Boss, look! VSK's gone!
Should we make our move now?
What if VSK suddenly comes back?
Heheh, I have a plan.
What is it?
We'll go out now and arrest them for drunk driving.
That way we'll be on the side of justice, representing justice punishing the guilty!
Won't VSK try to save her teammates?
When she returns, she'll find us bravely enforcing justice.
From what I know of VSK's background, she'll never oppose justice!
So you're saying... We pretend to be the law to recruit VSK?
You take that back!
From now on, we ARE the law!
Got that?
No problem!
Perfect!
Hehe, now let's do it!
You lot! Hands in the air!
...In Kalina's livestream room.
Kalina has her eyes clenched tight in anguish, while her fingers are rubbing her temples over and over again.
...Don't make me recall those painful memories again!
(Sobs) We had to pay so much in fines back then!
...Forget it, Kalin. It's been so long.
But whenever I remember paying off that fine, and seeing that huge sum leave my account...
It makes my heart ache!
Then you should look at the betting pool. Feel better now?
Waha! Hehehehe...
The tempting figures immediately boil away the tears brimming in the corners of Kalina's eyes.
Alright! Let's continue the stream!
All you Dolls watching the livestream, two teams have just undergone a huge member change!
VSK-94, formerly of Squad AK-47, has now been coaxed into joining Squad M870!
How much further will Squad AK-47 be able to go after losing one of their star players? And will Squad M870 gain a new lease of life?
Don't leave now, folks! Let's keep watching the progress of the game!
